guides.title: Before you flash anything
steps: Charge the phone to at least 60%.
Back up photos, chats and app data to your PC or cloud.
Note your exact model (DN2101 or DN2103) under Settings → About device.
Download only files made for your model, and check the SHA-256 when one is listed.
Install the latest ADB / fastboot platform-tools on your PC.

guides.title: Restore to stock (outline — fill in your tested steps)
steps: Download the full OxygenOS OTA for your model from the Files section.
Use the stock recovery's local install option, or your preferred official method.
Reboot and let the first boot finish fully before restoring any data.
Write down any step that behaved differently for you so this guide stays accurate.

guides.title: Back up your boot image
steps: Extract the boot.img from your current OTA package.
Store it with the build number in its file name.
Keep a copy off the phone. Never publish personal partitions such as persist or efs, since they hold device-specific data.
